instruction: I want to disable the minimap in the editor, please help modify the setting of VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires modifying VS Code settings to disable the minimap in the editor. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the setting is correctly applied in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable the minimap
Getter (get_vm_file) extracts the correct VS Code settings file from standard Linux location: /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) properly loads JSON and checks for expected key-value pair: editor.minimap.enabled=false
Data flow is semantically correct: file extraction -> JSON parsing -> key-value verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires disabling minimap, evaluator checks the exact setting that controls this feature
No postconfig needed: VS Code settings persist to disk automatically
Metric handles edge cases properly: missing files, JSON parse errors, and distinguishes missing keys from None values

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
